text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you there! Come get yourself a<n>good-morning
cuddle!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. That should cheer ya up! Oh,<n>looks like
somebody else needs a<n>good mood-boostin' too...

I've been out here squeezing some<n>energy into
anybody lookin' too<n>down in the dumps!

text_block_list.name: Taiki Shuttle
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to my day off yesterday, my<n>energy
reserves are overflowing!
It looks like Taiki Shuttle got in some<n>good rest.
